verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an end-to-end fine-tune-then-serve workflow: SFT/RFT training up to 1T+ params, guided task-to-trained-model flow, and multiple same-platform deployment options for the resulting LoRA (live merge or multi-LoRA via a single firectl command). This directly matches the ml-engineer story of training on custom data and serving on the same platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of fine-tuned model serving quality and reliability beyond first-party docs (the only community evidence found is an off-topic pricing complaint, not a functional contradiction).
